policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 10. Record six confirmed science-target Persons as verify-only science_retained checkpoints. No Person domain write is requested in this unit; every retained Person must remain live Production knowledge until final cutover.

review_scope.selection_rule: Continue the simple batch-008 provenance cohort from Unit 09, taking six clear mathematics, astronomy, chemistry, medicine, and experimental-science identities. Deliberately defer Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz as a real philosophy-mathematics boundary case.

science_retained.basis: Al-Khwarizmi's representative identity is mathematical and astronomical scholarship, especially algebra, arithmetic, astronomical tables, and mathematical geography. Under v2, mathematics and formal inquiry belong to science.

Archimedes is represented above all as a mathematician and investigator of mechanics and physical principles. His inventions are important, but his canonical historical identity is broader mathematical and scientific inquiry rather than engineering alone.
Ptolemy's representative identity is mathematical astronomy, with major work in astronomy, mathematics, and mathematical geography. This falls directly within the v2 science scope.

Jenner is represented as a physician and investigator whose experimental vaccination work against smallpox became foundational to immunization. Medicine and empirical medical inquiry are explicitly within v2 science.

Haber's representative identity is chemistry, especially physical chemistry and ammonia synthesis. Although the work had major industrial applications, his defining historical identity is scientific chemical research.

Galen's representative identity is medicine, anatomy, and experimental physiology. His philosophical writings do not outweigh his long-standing historical identity as physician and medical investigator; medicine is explicitly within v2 science.
